loiGiai: \begin{center} \end{center} Ta có $\overrightarrow{SA}=k\overrightarrow{F_1}$, $\overrightarrow{SB}=k\overrightarrow{F_2}$, $\overrightarrow{SC}=k\overrightarrow{F_3}$, $\overrightarrow{SD}=k\overrightarrow{F_4}$ (điều kiện $k>0$).\\ Với $\left| \overrightarrow{SA}+\overrightarrow{SB}+\overrightarrow{SC}+\overrightarrow{SD} \right|=4\left| \overrightarrow{SO} \right|=120$ và $\left| \overrightarrow{F_1}+\overrightarrow{F_2}+\overrightarrow{F_3}+\overrightarrow{F_4} \right|=60$. Suy ra $$60k=120 \Rightarrow k=2.$$ Khi đó \begin{eqnarray*} \left| \overrightarrow{F_1}+\overrightarrow{F_2}+\overrightarrow{F_3}-\overrightarrow{F_4} \right|&=&\dfrac{1}{2}\left| \overrightarrow{SA}+\overrightarrow{SB}+\overrightarrow{SC}-\overrightarrow{SD} \right|\\ &=& \dfrac{1}{2}\left| (\overrightarrow{SA}+\overrightarrow{SC})+\overrightarrow{SB}-\overrightarrow{SD} \right|\\ &=& \dfrac{1}{2}\left| 2\overrightarrow{SB}+\overrightarrow{SD}-\overrightarrow{SD} \right|\\ &=&\left| \overrightarrow{SB} \right|=30\sqrt{2}\approx 42. \end{eqnarray*}
